system.longDesc: You can sow confusion among friends and foes alike.

degree0.desc: You confound people so much they cannot react appropriately. As a major action, you can make a Communication (Deception) test opposed by an opponent’s Willpower (Self-Discipline); if you succeed, your opponent cannot use stunts until the end of your next turn.

degree1.desc: Your targets become too focused on you to do anything else. When you use the Over Here! exploration talent, the bonus your allies gain from the stunt is +2 instead of +1, and you also gain a +1 bonus.

degree2.desc: Your guile can help you through sticky situations. When you use a Communication focus in combat and roll doubles, you gain +1 SP.
